decision.decision: We can't fill this order from stock because CC-TEE-WHITE size S has 0 on hand. Accounting filed approval request #1 to pay overdue invoice 501 ($840.00) to Bulldog Print Co, because that open invoice is the only thing stopping the vendor from shipping. Once it's paid, we'll order 1x CC-TEE-WHITE S at $8.00. Draft 1 is ready to tell the customer about the delay.
decision.reasoning: The shop date is 2026-08-31. Inventory shows 0 units of CC-TEE-WHITE size S, and the ticket asks for 1, so we're 1 short. The restock vendor is Bulldog Print Co (vendor_id 1), with a 5-day lead time. That vendor has can_ship_new_product=false because invoice 501 ($840.00, due 2026-08-28) is still open and is now 3 days overdue. Accounting couldn't file the purchase order yet because the vendor is blocked. Checking holds $3,400.00 and nothing else is outstanding. Paying the invoice would leave $2,560.00, and the $8.00 tee would leave $2,552.00, so cash covers both. The tee costs $8.00 and lists at $28.00, a 71.4% margin. If request #1 is approved and the order goes in today, the earliest arrival is 2026-09-05. Each day the approval waits pushes that date back. Invoice 501 is described as 'Rush reprint CC-TEE-WHITE S', so that earlier reprint may already cover this unit.
next_steps: Owner: review and approve request #1 ($840.00, invoice 501) on the dashboard. Approving it pays the invoice automatically.
Owner: check whether the rush reprint on invoice 501 already covers this size S tee, to avoid ordering a duplicate.
Owner: review draft 1 to Tauhid Zaman and send it. It gives 2026-09-05 as the earliest arrival and makes no firm promise.
After the payment goes through, re-run ticket 101. Accounting will then file a purchase order for 1x CC-TEE-WHITE S from Bulldog Print Co at $8.00, which also needs approval.

After the purchase order is approved and placed, the ticket moves to waiting_on_vendor. The expected arrival is the order date plus 5 days. Customer Service will draft a follow-up with the confirmed date, and Inventory will reserve the unit when it arrives.
